style_summary: Analog editorial photography meets local square displacement, restless ivory cut lettering and a fine woven print grid. Four content-led reinterpretations explore circular rhythm, bodily motion, an organic spiral and architectural steps.

environment_variables.SUBJECT: Photographic subject and palette
environment_variables.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Theme interaction and separate plans for both aspect ratios

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] Oversized warm ivory cut-paper sans-serif letters with uneven baselines, varied rotations and scale; expressive but instantly readable.
[CORE] High-contrast analog photographic cutouts disrupted locally by square pixel tiles that retain recognizable image fragments, not an all-over mosaic.
[CORE] A cool muted color field opposes warm highlights and near-black shadows, with one saturated subject accent.
[CORE] A tactile printed surface and fine rectilinear grid unify photography, lettering and background.
[FLEX] Title placement, silhouette and negative space respond to each theme; portraits are not required.
[FLEX] Square displacement can express rhythm, motion, peeling or architectural steps while leaving the subject legible.
[FLEX] Recompose portrait and landscape independently with balanced text and focal mass, rather than cropping one into the other.
source_content_to_avoid: Hands covering the face and the original facial identity
The word Fashion and all original slogans
Original footer text, creator identifiers or brand marks

visual_deconstruction.source_observations: The supplied portrait has enormous irregular ivory lettering, a green cap, warm hands, a cool blue field, square-displaced photographic fragments, small white copy and a tactile ruled print finish.
visual_deconstruction.reusable_system: Cut typography, selective square collage and analog surface unify the design; cap, gesture and exact layout are source content.

composition.hierarchy: Oversized readable title and an assertive photographic mass; small supporting copy in useful negative space.
composition.adaptation: Use the ratio-specific design direction; do not preserve a universal title band or center portrait.

typography.headline: Warm ivory heavy grotesque cut letters, irregular rotation and baseline, varied size but intact glyphs.
typography.support: Small plain white condensed sans-serif, exact wording, modest line breaks allowed.

color_palette.base: Dusty blue, slate blue or muted teal
color_palette.accent: Emerald, brick red, citrus orange or coral concrete according to subject

image_treatment: Fine embossed paper fibers across the whole poster at moderate strength, delicate pale vertical and horizontal ruling, visible coarse halftone dots in selected dark/photo regions. Intentionally slightly soft warm analog photo highlights and crisp square-cut tile boundaries. No thick dirt, extreme aging or indiscriminate digital noise.
design_rules: Use tile displacement on selected meaningful edges, not every surface.
Keep title letters complete enough to read every word.
Make the subject action or geometry determine the image-text interaction.
Use only the two specified text strings, without invented logos or filler copy.
do: Retain analog photographic lighting and material detail.
Create distinct silhouette and spatial logic per case.
Use the grid as a subtle unifying overlay.
avoid: Do not repeat the source cap-and-hands portrait.
Do not make four interchangeable centered-object posters.
Do not replace real photography with flat vector illustration or glossy CGI.
negative_prompt: Original cap portrait or hands over face, copied source headline, watermark, logos, QR code, illegible or extra copy, all-over pixelation, uniform smooth vector look, glossy CGI, extra fingers or limbs, unrelated decorative clutter, four-panel montage.

values.SUBJECT: An overhead black vinyl record with a vivid brick-red center label, unbranded, lying on a dusty blue surface. Hard side light reveals concentric grooves.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Make the circular groove the visual engine: one sector breaks into square photographic steps that curl away like a short musical phrase. The record must remain clearly circular and physically photographic. Portrait: giant tilted LOOP above an off-center record in lower two thirds with a curling tile tail upward. Landscape: record cropped at left outer edge, tile rhythm bridges to generous LOOP at right, supporting copy in open blue space.

values.SUBJECT: One adult contemporary street dancer, full body, in an oversized emerald windbreaker, charcoal wide trousers and plain cream shoes, caught in a sweeping sideways airborne leap. Dusty slate-blue studio backdrop; warm side light.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Let the bent legs and outstretched arms form a diagonal lightning-shaped silhouette. A few square photographic echoes trail the jacket and trouser edges, expressing movement without duplicating limbs. Portrait: dancer runs diagonally through the central open space, staggered large LEAP follows the upward energy, supporting copy in a quiet corner. Landscape: full-body leap stretches from left to right, title interlocks with empty space above and below the action; hands and face remain natural.

values.SUBJECT: A monumental real orange partly peeled, with one long curling orange peel ribbon, suspended against dusty teal-blue. Pith, pores and juicy pulp are tactile, warm and photographic.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: The peel forms an open spiral and transforms only at its far tip into square image fragments; use the spiral void as a deliberate typographic counterspace. Portrait: fruit hangs high at the right, long spiral descends with PEEL woven across its open center without covering the fruit. Landscape: orange anchors the right third, curl sweeps left around the title, preserving a broad teal opening. Avoid a literal face or person.

values.SUBJECT: Low-angle architectural photograph of a single weathered coral-red concrete exterior stair tower and a dark void beneath its landings, cut against muted powder-blue sky. Strong afternoon light, no people.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Turn the real staircase geometry into a dialogue with square image displacement: a few blocks along the landing edges step outward into the sky. Preserve credible concrete construction and readable stair geometry. Portrait: upward zigzag staircase dominates the right two thirds; oversized SHIFT has an ascending cut-letter rhythm at lower left, sky opens above. Landscape: stairs cut diagonally across the right, title rises across left sky, small copy sits beside the deep shadow. Architecture rather than a generic central object.
